status: conditional hadronic matching witness for universal light-quark axial coefficients

source.title: Nucleon axial, tensor and scalar charges and sigma-terms in lattice QCD
source.ensemble: cB211.072.64 at approximately physical pion mass
source.valuesAre: final renormalized single-flavor proton axial charges from Table 11

matching.assumption: c_e=c_u=c_d=c_s=1/8 at a common matched normalization; heavy flavors omitted
matching.isospin: Delta u_n=Delta d_p, Delta d_n=Delta u_p, Delta s_n=Delta s_p, so the universal light-flavor sum is equal for proton and neutron

uncertainty.method: quadrature of the three quoted single-flavor lattice uncertainties, neglecting correlations and uncertainty in the experimental limit
uncertainty.qualification: illustrative propagation only; a precision result requires the lattice covariance and consistently run quark Wilson coefficients

scope.established: universal u,d,s coefficients are suppressed at nucleon level by the light-quark singlet axial charge, yielding c_p=c_n about 0.049 for c_q=1/8
scope.notEstablished: the Spin(2,3) parent predicts universal quark coefficients, the matching convention is UV complete, or heavy-quark/anomaly threshold effects vanish
scope.decision: this conditional witness closes the simplest hadronic branch but does not turn either laboratory null result into a model fingerprint; the electron-electron bound remains decisive for the minimal universal benchmark
